---
title: Meeting of South West RSEs at the University of Bath
---

**When**: Friday 31st July 2026, 10am – 4:00pm (refreshments from 9:30am for a 10am start)<br>
**Where**: 10 West 2.47, University of Bath, Claverton Down, Bath, BA2 7AY (A3 on [campus map](https://www.bath.ac.uk/publications/claverton-down-campus-map/attachments/university-campus-map.pdf))

## Purpose

It will be another day to showcase interesting topics, share knowledge and build networks.
All are welcome, whether or not you are from the South West of the UK, and whether or not you self-define as a Research Software Engineer (RSE).
[What is an RSE?](https://society-rse.org/what-is-an-rse/)

## Outline Agenda

Details of talks to follow.

- 9:30-10:00 Welcome refreshments
- 10:00-10:15 Introduction
- 10:15-11:00 Keynote speaker
- 11:00-11:20 Morning refreshments
- 11:20-12:20 Contributed talks 1
- 12:20-13:20 Lunch
- 13:20-14:20 Contributed talks 2
- 14:20-14:40 Afternoon refreshments
- 14:40-15:30 Contributed talks 3 and discussion
- 15:30-15:35 Close
- Social

In the interim before the full agenda is released, here is a flavour of contributed talks (titles paraphrased):
- SSEs in space weather
- COVID-19 impact assessed with OpenSAFELY platform
- RSE to policy: GIS toolkit for local government
- Advancing learning resources for iterative customer-focused research software
- EESSI: the Initiative for Software Usage on HPCs
- ML for visibility range forecasting
- Lessons for DAFNI research platform
- Centres for Mathematical Innovation at Bath and Bristol

## Code of conduct

All participants are expected to adhere to the [Society of RSE code of conduct for events](https://society-rse.org/about/policies/code-of-conduct/).

This event is being organised by the RSE Facility at Bath.
To get in touch, find contact details on the [Facility Lead's Website](https://people.bath.ac.uk/spc67/).
